notes.1876-07-08: South Bend, Ind. fall lead (fragment in a Scott St. yard) is reported as a piece of this fireball, which is independently documented across Indiana. That gives the lead a dated parent event.
notes.1870-10-23: New England: exploded with sound; several towns claimed the remains (West Brookfield / New Braintree, Shaker Pond). The 1870-10-30 event is mostly this one misdated; Rupert/Hebron 'another' at 4 a.m. may be a second meteor.
notes.1873-12-24: Christmas Eve, Virginia/DC; exploded near Fairfax Courthouse; the Philosophical Society of Washington appealed for observations.
notes.1893-09-21: Louisiana; Natchitoches heard the explosion some minutes after the light, which papers used to place the fall 15-40 miles SW.
notes.1874-07-07: Tennessee/Kentucky; Columbia, Tenn. woman claimed a white chalky fragment (weak).
